items.t: CVT slipping, hesitating or failing
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report $3,000-4,900. One dealer quoted about $5,000.

items.t: CVT surging or not holding a steady speed
items.job: Update transmission computer software and change CVT fluid

items.t: Electronic steering lock fails and the car won't start
items.job: Replace electronic steering column lock unit
items.note: Owners report about $450-970, and CarComplaints lists about $800-900.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can come loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver airbag inflator (recall)

items.t: Fuel can leak and create a fire risk (recall)
items.job: Fuel system leak repair (recall)

items.t: Tire can lose air from a tire pressure system defect (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair tire pressure sensor parts (recall)
items.note: Outside the recall, owners report a valve stem alone is inexpensive, while a stem plus sensor costs much more.

items.t: Start/stop button can stick and shut off the engine (recall)
items.job: Repair engine start/stop switch (recall)

items.t: Exhaust flex joint or muffler rusts and breaks
items.job: Replace exhaust flex pipe or muffler section
items.note: Owners report $40-630 depending on how much of the exhaust is replaced.

items.t: Catalytic converter failure
items.job: Replace catalytic converter

items.t: Brake light switch failure stops the car from starting
items.job: Replace brake light (stop lamp) switch

items.t: Rattle or vibration at idle from worn engine mounts
items.job: Replace engine or torque rod mount

items.t: Check engine light with a mass airflow code
items.job: Clean or replace mass airflow sensor

items.t: Rear door won't open from the latch or remote
items.job: Replace rear door latch actuator

items.t: Water leaks into the cargo area
items.job: Clean or replace rear door weather seal and dry interior

items.t: Humming from a worn wheel bearing
items.job: Replace wheel bearing and hub assembly
items.note: Owners report $80-151 per bearing and up to $1,300 for all four.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit

items.t: Fuel door latch breaks
items.job: Replace fuel door latch (opener) assembly

items.t: Airbag light on and horn stops working
items.job: Replace spiral cable (clock spring)

items.t: Heater blower grinds or only works on some speeds
items.job: Replace blower motor or blower resistor
items.note: Owners report $40 for a resistor and about $300 for a blower motor.

items.t: Check engine light from an EVAP vent valve
items.job: Replace EVAP vent control valve
items.note: One owner paid about $744 including diagnosis and computer reprogramming.

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
items.job: Reseal timing chain cover

items.t: Power window switch fails
items.job: Replace driver power window master switch
